g.text: Each stage is idempotent and records completion, so a crashed job resumes. The photo is usable after stage 4; everything else enriches it.

g.text: Throughput on 4 vCPU, no GPU: 2–4 photos/s end to end · a 500-photo event completes in under five minutes · Florence runs late so People and search are live before captions exist.
